notes.title: ArtPose Pro 2.01 is now live.
notes.content:
We have pushed the 2.01 update live on steam this includes bug fixes for small issues and some big ones for people that could not launch the application.  The big addition to the application is Props.  We have included Props that can be added to the hands or placed in the scene to create a complete scene.  
This version also rolls in many of the fixes from the last 3 updates to the iOS version. future updates will contain additional props.  All updates will be free.  Stay safe.
